<js>
function transformChapters(result) {
const sourceVar = source.getVariable();
let debug = "0";
if (sourceVar) {
const debugMatch = sourceVar.match(/debug=([^&]+)/);
if (debugMatch) {
debug = debugMatch[1];
}
}
const jsonData = JSON.parse(result);
const data = jsonData.Data;
const imageChapters = {};
(data.BlockChapters || []).forEach(x => { if (x && x.ChapterId != null) imageChapters[String(x.ChapterId)] = true; });
const { BookId, CanReadFree, VipLen, TotalPrice, Volumes, Chapters } = data;
if (debug === "1") {
java.log("BookId: " + BookId);
java.log("CanReadFree: " + CanReadFree);
java.log("VipLen: " + VipLen);
java.log("TotalPrice: " + TotalPrice);
java.log("Volumes: " + JSON.stringify(Volumes));
java.log("Chapters: " + JSON.stringify(Chapters));
}
const volumeMap = {};
for (let volIndex in Volumes) {
const v = Volumes[volIndex];
volumeMap[v.VolumeCode] = v.VolumeName;
}
let midpageMap = {};
try {
midpageMap = qtMidpageChapters(BookId);
if (debug === "1") java.log("彩蛋章锚点数：" + Object.keys(midpageMap).length);
} catch (e) {
midpageMap = {};
}
let transformedList = [];
for (let chapterIndex in Chapters) {
if (debug === "1") {
java.log("Processing Chapter Index: " + chapterIndex);
}
let chapter = Chapters[chapterIndex];
if (String(chapter.N) === "版权信息" || !chapter.C) continue;
if (debug === "1") {
java.log("Chapter Data: " + JSON.stringify(chapter));
}
let isVip = String(chapter.V === undefined || chapter.V === null ? "0" : chapter.V) === "1";
let volumeCode = chapter.Vc;
let volumeName = volumeMap[volumeCode];
let isVolume = volumeName === chapter.N;
let displayTime = chapter.DisplayTime;
let formattedDate = '';
if (displayTime && displayTime > 0) {
formattedDate = java.timeFormat(displayTime );
} else {
formattedDate = '1970/01/01';
}
let wordCount = chapter.W || 0;
let info = `${formattedDate} · ${wordCount}`;
let normalApi = "https://qdgo.qimo.host/api/content?bookId=" + String(BookId) + "&chapterId=" + String(chapter.C) + "&V=" + String(chapter.V === undefined || chapter.V === null ? "" : chapter.V);
let chapterUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(normalApi)},{"type":"QSMX"}`;
transformedList.push({
isVip: isVip,
ChapterName: String(chapter.N) + (imageChapters[String(chapter.C)] && !isVolume ? " ▧" : ""),
isVolume: isVolume,
Info: info,
ChapterId: chapter.C,
ChapterUrl: chapterUrl
});
const eggs = midpageMap[String(chapter.C)] || [];
for (let eggIndex = 0; eggIndex < eggs.length; eggIndex++) {
const egg = eggs[eggIndex];
const eggId = String(chapter.C) + "_" + egg.midpageId;
let eggDate = "";
try { if (egg.updateTime > 0) eggDate = java.timeFormat(egg.updateTime); } catch (e) {}
transformedList.push({
isVip: false,
ChapterName: "🎬 " + egg.name,
isVolume: false,
Info: (eggDate ? eggDate + " · " : "") + "彩蛋章",
ChapterId: eggId,
ChapterUrl: `data:chapter_info;base64,${java.base64Encode(String(BookId) + "," + eggId + ",egg")},{"type":"qdreader"}`
});
}
if (debug === "1") {
java.log("Processed Chapter: " + JSON.stringify({
isVip: isVip,
ChapterName: chapter.N,
isVolume: isVolume,
Info: info,
ChapterId: chapter.C,
ChapterUrl: chapterUrl
}));
}
}
if (debug === "1") {
java.log("Transformed List: " + JSON.stringify(transformedList));
}
return transformedList;
}
transformChapters(result);

transformChapters(result);
</js>
